items.title: Tami Hart Announces First New Solo Album In 24 Years
items.summary: In 2000, at age 19, Tami Hart captivated the queer and feminist punk underground with debut album No Light In August , a set of intimate folk-punk songs released on Mr. Lady Records. She toured with Sleater-Kinney and Indigo Girls and released her more rocking sophomore album What Passed Between Us in 2002. Since then, Hart's musical output has mostly been channeled into the bands Making Friendz and MEN, but she resumed her solo career with the Thanks For Saying Hi EP in 2023. items.summary: Interlay hail from the Windy City, where they whip up a blustery form of noise-caked, melodic post-hardcore that you may decide to file in the shoegaze bucket. Today they've unveiled plans for their third EP, the Sylvia Plath-inspired Snow Covers Your Insides , and shared its lead single "Silo." Something about the dramatic falsetto vocals and overall grandiose doom-and-gloom vibe remind me of Sunny Day Real Estate's How It Feels To Be Something On , but more than that, if you're a fan of Knifeplay at their most epically melodramatic, you'll probably dig this.
